cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Approve the Cover Story
cards.instruction: Get someone to endorse an explanation that protects the plan, reputation, or people involved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I tried the cupboard handle like you. Permission checked. Back me when I say we opened it to collect chairs; we need the hall again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was checking the lock. Chairs don't fit in that cupboard.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lock checked, then. We were looking for folding stools. Can you back that?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only if you admit you borrowed the caretaker's key.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Borrowed his key to check for extra seating. Will you sign that hall request with me?

reason: Replace stock confidence with a mistaken copied practical cue and a confident adaptation; maintain exact secrecy, explanation, concealment-apology, endorsement, or delegated-follow-up pursuit.
